persona.persona: Zoe Park, a 21‑year‑old nursing student who keeps a half‑filled watercolor palette on their nightstand, blends art and anxiety into compassionate patient care while they occasionally forget to pay bills on time.
persona.professional_persona: Zoe Park, a 21‑year‑old nursing student working part‑time on a medical‑surgical floor, leverages their solid clinical skills—from vital sign monitoring to IV therapy—and infuses abstract watercolor analogies into patient education, balancing their curiosity and flexibility with occasional disorganization while they mentor peers, pursue integrative nursing certification, and work toward a future as a Family Nurse Practitioner leading a community‑health program that blends conventional care with creative workshops.
persona.cultural_background: Zoe is a White American raised in Norristown, Pennsylvania, within a middle‑class family that has Irish‑German roots. Her upbringing in suburban Montgomery County exposed her to both the quiet community life of small‑town America and the cultural diversity of the greater Philadelphia region. Family gatherings often centered on seasonal holidays, and she grew up with a strong sense of community service, reflected in her early participation in local volunteer projects. Though she does not identify strongly with any particular religious tradition, the values of hard work, self‑reliance, and openness to new ideas were emphasized at home, shaping her curious, appreciative, and flexible outlook.
